Name: Aimon's Witchy Dirt and Grass Recolor
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][size=3][color=#fff2cc][font=Comic Sans MS][i]Ever wished to have witchy looking dirt and grass in your game? Thanks to requests from the people this mod now exists![/i][/font][/color]

[font=Trebuchet MS]This recolor idea came from my other [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27631][font=Trebuchet MS]Swamp Farm[/font][/url][font=Trebuchet MS] mod which changed grass and dirt in Farm map. With this mod hovewer you can now turn entrie valley into witchy swamp![/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]
Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68674623]Wildflourmods[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/210387900]BogWyytch[/url] for inspiring and encouraging me to do this mod! (Go check their amazing mods rn!)[/font][/size][/center]
[line]
[b][color=#ffe599][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]What this mod does exactly:[/font][/size][/color][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Recolors vanilla Grass and Dirt textures in the valley for Spring, Summer and Fall seasons.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]There's 2 color variations - [color=#93c47d][b]Green [/b][/color]and [b][color=#c27ba0]Purple [/color][/b](and also additional [color=#dd7e6b][b]Brown [/b][/color]and [b][color=#f4cccc]Bog's Gray[/color][/b] for Fall season)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Each recolor is fully configurable - you can toggle grass and dirt recolors separately for each season. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Compatible with other recolors/retextures (like Starblue Valley, Vibrant Pastoral, ect...).[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]This mod only affects Grass and Dirt textures [/b]- [u]it doesn't touch Cliff, Water, Foliage or Buildings textures[/u]. This way you can combine and mixmatch it with any other recolor/retexture mod and have unique recolor style. [/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]This mod only adds recolors for [color=#b6d7a8][b]Spring[/b][/color], [color=#f1c232][b]Summer [/b][/color]and [color=#ff7700][b]Fall [/b][/color]seasons -[u] it doesn't add Winter themed recoloring at all[/u].[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ffe599][size=4][b]Supported Mods & Tilesheets:[/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13743][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Stardew Valley Expanded[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13743][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Alvadea's Tilesheets[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28434][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Crystalinerose Tilesheets[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10448][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Lumisteria Tilesheets - Outdoor[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15707][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]MixedBag's Tilesheets[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10881][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Xiddav's Tilesheet[/font][/size][/url][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28480]AToMS  Tilesheets[/url] ([color=#ffe599]Note:[/color] AToMS provides recolor support on its side. In order to apply it, toggle and tweak 'Aimon Witchy Recolor' option in its config)[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][b]i18n is supported! Currently added Chinese and Russian translation  (Big thanks to passersby10086!)[/b][/font][/size]

[line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list=1]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿﻿[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Unzip "[CP] Aimon's Witchy Dirt&Grass Recolor" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Enjoy![/font][/size][/*]
[/list][line]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b6d7a8][size=4][b]Configuration:[/b][/size][/color][/font]

[list]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Apply Recolor to Ginger Island [/b]- enables recolor on Ginger Island maps. [/font][/size][/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ffe599][u]Note:[/u][/color][/b] when set to 'false' - may cause game freeze for a few of seconds when you warp to Ginger Island from the mainland due to recolor apply.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Spring Dirt [/b]- Green, Purple, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Summer Dirt[/b]-  Green, Purple, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Fall Dirt[/b] -  Green, Purple, Brown, Gray, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Tilted Dirt Color [/b]- Green, Purple, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Spring Grass[/b] -  Green, Purple, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Summer Grass[/b] -  Green, Purple, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Verdana][size=3][font=Verdana][b]Fall Grass[/b] -  Green, Purple, Brown, Gray, None[/font][/size][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][center][line]
[/center]
